name: Overloading Arch (1-2)
source: Pathfinder Society Special #3-99: Fate in the Future
description: The Eternity Arch sparks with electricity, releasing bolts of lightning at each of the four largest time rifts.
disable: DC 20 Thievery (trained) or DC 18 Arcana , DC 18 Nature , DC 18 Occultism , or DC 18 Religion (trained) to seal each of the four time rifts, DC 20 Crafting (trained) to divert the lightning to another source, or Dispel Magic (1st rank; counteract DC 17) to counteract each time rift. Each attempt requires 2 actions. Skill checks to disable a time rift must attempted from adjacent to the rift.
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action each turn for each disabled time rift. On each of the trap's actions, the Eternity Arch releases a bolt of lightning that activates that rift, dealing 2d6 Electricity Damage damage to all creatures in a 10ft Emanation around the time rift (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save). It can release a bolt at each active time rift no more than once each turn.

generalAbilities.name: Shock
generalAbilities.description:
Trigger A creature approaches within 10 feet of one of the time rifts

Effect The triggering creature takes 1d6 Electricity Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save). The overloading arch rolls initiative.
